cache_identity.protocol: Native apply_chat_template defaults, no rationale generation; every labeled causal prefix must match full dialogue; any rejection blocks all GPU work.
cache_identity.padding: right to128; one complete dialog per forward

weighting.dispersion: population std of all labeled action tokens in current dialog
weighting.normalization: softmax within each action; mean actions; mean four dialogs
